zh.name: 未来1-10年新词义与语义空白
zh.gap: 当新技术、新制度和新生活形态出现时，旧词会被迫承担新的指称、评价和关系功能。
lexical: 旧词新义
隐喻扩展
转喻扩展
术语日常化
日常词术语化
zh.note: 一级领域平行展开；二级领域指未来较可能产生语义空白的位置；三级节点给出可观察的新义方向。

en.name: New Word Meanings and Semantic Gaps in the Next 1–10 Years
en.gap: When new technologies, new institutions and new lifestyles emerge, existing words are forced to take on new referential, evaluative and relational functions.
lexical: new meaning of old words
metaphorical extension
metonymic extension
popularization of technical terms
terminologization of common words
en.note: Level-1 domains are expanded in parallel; level-2 domains refer to positions where semantic gaps are more likely to emerge in the future; level-3 nodes provide observable directions of new meaning emergence.

zh.name: 智能体与协作认知
zh.gap: 软件从“工具”转向能计划、协商和执行的行动者，旧有的“助手、代理、同事、责任”等词需要重分边界。
lexical: 代理
同事
委托
接管
共签

en.name: AI Agents and Collaborative Cognition
en.gap: As software shifts from 'tools' to actors capable of planning, negotiation and execution, the boundaries of existing words such as 'assistant, agent, colleague, responsibility' need to be redefined.
lexical: agent
colleague
entrustment
takeover
co-signing

zh.name: 多智能体工作流
zh.gap: 多个AI代理协同完成任务时，缺少描述“机器之间分工、交接、争议解决”的日常词。
lexical: 代理编队
任务接力
数字工段

en.name: Multi-Agent Workflow
en.gap: When multiple AI agents collaborate to complete tasks, there is a lack of common words to describe 'division of labor, handover and dispute resolution between machines'.
lexical: agent formation
task relay
digital work section

zh.name: 委托边界
zh.gap: 人把判断权暂时交给系统，但责任未完全转移。
lexical: 委托: 从人际授权扩展为人机授权
接管: 从临时控制扩展为流程自治
越权: 从组织行为扩展为AI行为

en.name: Delegation Boundary
en.gap: Users temporarily hand over decision-making authority to the system, but full responsibility transfer has not been completed.
lexical: delegation: extends from interpersonal authorization to human-machine authorization
takeover: extends from temporary control to process autonomy
exceeding authority: extends from organizational behavior to AI behavior

zh.name: 机器交接
zh.gap: 不同模型或代理接续处理同一任务，语言需要标记上下文、权限和目标的移交。
lexical: 交接: 从岗位移交扩展为上下文移交
接力: 从体育隐喻扩展为代理链路
断点: 从程序状态扩展为协作记忆

en.name: Machine Handoff
en.gap: Different models or agents take over processing the same task in sequence, requiring the handover of context, permissions and objectives to be marked in the language.
lexical: handoff: extends from post transfer to context transfer
relay: extends from a sports metaphor to agent chain
breakpoint: extends from program state to collaborative memory

zh.name: 代理协商
zh.gap: AI之间为资源、目标或策略进行协调，现有“协商”词义带有人类意图色彩。
lexical: 协商: 从人际谈判扩展为算法协调
让步: 从心理动作扩展为目标权重调整
共识: 从意见一致扩展为模型输出收敛

en.name: Agent Negotiation
en.gap: AI systems coordinate with each other for resources, objectives or strategies; the existing definition of 'negotiation' carries the connotation of human intent.
lexical: negotiation: extends from interpersonal negotiation to algorithmic coordination
concession: extends from a psychological action to target weight adjustment
consensus: extends from alignment of opinions to convergence of model outputs

zh.name: 行业专用模型
zh.gap: 通用模型进入医疗、法律、金融、教育等专业场景后，需要表达“专业语境中的可解释、合规和可信”。
lexical: 领域语感
模型资质
合规语料

en.name: Industry-Specific Models
en.gap: After general-purpose models are applied to professional scenarios such as healthcare, law, finance and education, they need to embody 'interpretability, compliance and trustworthiness in professional contexts'.
lexical: domain language sense
model credential
compliance corpus

zh.name: 领域语感
zh.gap: 模型能否理解专业共同体的隐含规则，不只是词汇匹配。
lexical: 语感: 从人的语言直觉扩展为模型的场景适配
懂行: 从经验判断扩展为领域模型能力
内行话: 从群体口语扩展为训练数据特征

en.name: Domain Language Sense
en.gap: The model's ability to understand the implicit rules of the professional community goes beyond mere lexical matching.
lexical: language sense: extends from human linguistic intuition to model scenario adaptation
industry expertise: extends from empirical judgment to domain model capability
insider jargon: extends from group colloquialism to training data feature

zh.name: 模型资质
zh.gap: 模型被用于专业判断时，缺少类似执照、资质、审验等级的表达。
lexical: 资质: 从人的资格扩展为模型可用范围
执业: 从职业行为扩展为模型服务边界
背书: 从机构信用扩展为模型审验

en.name: Model Credential
en.gap: When models are used for professional judgment, there is a lack of representations equivalent to licenses, qualifications, and verification levels.
lexical: qualification: extends from human professional qualification to model applicable scope
practice: extends from professional conduct to model service boundary
endorsement: extends from institutional credit to model verification

zh.name: 合规语料
zh.gap: 语料不再只是数据来源，还带有版权、隐私、行业规范和地域限制。
lexical: 语料: 从语言材料扩展为合规资产
清洁: 从卫生评价扩展为数据授权状态
投喂: 从喂养隐喻扩展为训练输入

en.name: Regulated Corpus
en.gap: Corpus is no longer just a data source, but also carries copyright, privacy, industry specification and regional restrictions.
lexical: word: extends from language material to compliant asset
clean: extends from hygiene evaluation to data authorization status
feeding: extends from feeding metaphor to training input

zh.name: AI原生开发
zh.gap: 软件生成从写代码转向表达意图、审校结果和治理流程，旧的“开发者、代码、原型”词义被重写。
lexical: 意图即代码
小队开发
生成债

en.name: AI-Native Development
en.gap: Software generation shifts from writing code to expressing intent, reviewing results and governing processes, and the old semantics of 'developer, code, prototype' are rewritten.
lexical: Intent is Code
Squad Development
Generation Debt

zh.name: 意图即代码
zh.gap: 自然语言需求可直接变成可运行软件，代码的边界向意图层上移。
lexical: 代码: 从程序文本扩展为可执行意图
写: 从手工输入扩展为提示生成
原型: 从草模扩展为即时可用系统

en.name: Intent is Code
en.gap: Natural language requirements can be directly converted into runnable software, and the boundary of code shifts up to the intent layer.
lexical: code: extends from program text to executable intent
write: extends from manual input to prompt generation
prototype: extends from rough model to instantly usable system

zh.name: 小队式开发
zh.gap: 少数人加一组AI工具完成过去大团队的工作，需要新词描述团队规模和协作身份。
lexical: 团队: 从人群扩展为人机组合
搭子: 从社交伙伴扩展为任务代理
工位: 从物理座位扩展为数字职能

en.name: Squad-style development
en.gap: A small number of people plus a set of AI tools can complete work that used to require large teams; new terms are needed to describe team size and collaborative identities.
lexical: team: extends from human group to human-AI combination
buddy: extends from social partner to task agent
workstation: extends from physical seat to digital function role

zh.name: 生成债
zh.gap: AI快速生成的系统可能积累不可见的维护、验证和责任成本。
lexical: 债: 从财务负担扩展为生成系统的后续成本
返工: 从人工修正扩展为模型输出校验
烂尾: 从项目停滞扩展为无人维护的AI产物

en.name: Generation debt
en.gap: Systems rapidly generated by AI may accumulate invisible maintenance, verification and liability costs.
lexical: debt: extends from financial burden to follow-up costs of generative systems
rework: extends from manual correction to model output verification
unfinished project: extends from stalled project to unmaintained AI output

zh.name: 物理AI与机器人世界
zh.gap: 智能进入机器身体、道路、仓库和家庭空间，语言要把“会动的工具”和“可协作的行动体”区分开。
lexical: 身体
工友
路线礼仪
场景训练
机器手感

en.name: Physical AI and the robotic world
en.gap: Intelligence is entering robotic bodies, roads, warehouses and home spaces; language needs to distinguish between 'movable tools' and 'collaborative actors'.
lexical: body
workmate
route etiquette
scenario training
machine tactile sense

zh.name: 具身模型与通用机器人
zh.gap: 模型拥有传感器和执行器后，理解不再只是语言，旧的“身体、经验、手感”会被技术化。
lexical: 机器身体
世界模型
触觉语义

en.name: Embodied Models and General Robots
en.gap: After models are equipped with sensors and actuators, understanding is no longer limited to language, and the traditional concepts of 'body, experience, and tactile feel' will be technologized.
lexical: Machine Body
World Model
Tactile Semantics

zh.name: 机器身体
zh.gap: 机器人不只是外壳，而是感知、行动和学习的统一载体。
lexical: 身体: 从生物躯体扩展为可行动平台
身手: 从人的动作能力扩展为机器人灵活度
体感: 从人类感觉扩展为机器传感反馈

en.name: Machine Body
en.gap: A robot is not just a shell, but a unified carrier for perception, action, and learning.
lexical: body: extends from biological organism to actionable platform
dexterity: extends from human movement ability to robot flexibility
somatosensory: extends from human sensation to machine sensor feedback

zh.name: 场景训练
zh.gap: 机器人需要在模拟和真实场景中积累经验，训练对象从模型扩展到动作。

练手: 从人类熟练过程扩展为机器人试错
经验: 从人生经历扩展为轨迹数据

en.name: Scenario Training
en.gap: Robots need to accumulate experience in simulated and real scenarios, and the training target extends from models to movements.

practice: extends from human skill acquisition process to robot trial and error
experience: extends from life experience to trajectory data

zh.name: 触觉语义
zh.gap: 抓、按、揉、避让等动作包含物理意义，现有语义分析偏重文本和视觉。

轻重: 从力度描述扩展为安全策略
拿捏: 从社交分寸扩展为机器人抓取控制

en.name: tactile semantics
en.gap: Actions such as grasping, pressing, kneading, and avoidance carry physical meaning, while existing semantic analysis focuses heavily on text and vision.
lexical: hand feel: extends from human tactile evaluation to machine operation parameters
heaviness/lightness: extends from force description to security policy
handling: extends from social propriety to robot grasping control

zh.name: 无人系统与低空经济
zh.gap: 无人车、无人机和自动船进入公共空间，会制造交通礼仪、责任归属和空间命名的新空白。
lexical: 空路
机群礼让
无人勤务

en.name: unmanned systems and low-altitude economy
en.gap: As unmanned vehicles, drones and autonomous ships enter public spaces, they will create new gaps in traffic etiquette, liability attribution and spatial naming.
lexical: air route
drone fleet courtesy
unmanned service duty

zh.name: 低空走廊
zh.gap: 城市上空从不可见空间变成可规划交通层。
lexical: 路: 从地面通道扩展为空中航线
拥堵: 从道路状态扩展为低空流量
站点: 从地面设施扩展为起降节点

en.name: low-altitude corridor
en.gap: Urban airspace is transformed from an invisible space into a plannable traffic layer.
lexical: road: extends from ground passage to aerial route
congestion: extends from road status to low-altitude traffic flow
station: extends from ground facility to takeoff and landing node

zh.name: 机器礼仪
zh.gap: 自动系统与行人、骑手和车辆互动时，需要稳定的让行、提示和道歉表达。
lexical: 礼让: 从人类道德行为扩展为自动决策
示意: 从身体动作扩展为灯光/声音信号
道歉: 从情感表达扩展为服务补救协议

en.name: Machine Etiquette
en.gap: When automated systems interact with pedestrians, riders and vehicles, stable yielding, prompting and apology expressions are required.
lexical: comity: extends from human moral behavior to automated decision-making
signal: extends from body movements to light/sound signals
apology: extends from emotional expression to service remedy protocols

zh.name: 无人勤务
zh.gap: 巡检、配送、清洁等工作由无人系统承担后，工作角色词需要扩展。

上岗: 从人到岗扩展为机器上线
值班: 从轮班制度扩展为系统持续运行

en.name: Autonomous Duty Performance
en.gap: After tasks such as inspection, delivery and cleaning are undertaken by unmanned systems, job role terms need to be expanded.
lexical: duty performance: extends from on-duty personnel to automated task execution

on duty: extends from shift scheduling system to continuous system operation

zh.name: 柔性制造与智能工厂
zh.gap: 制造从固定产线转向实时重组的智能网络，旧的“师傅、工位、产线”获得新义。
lexical: 数字师傅
黑灯协作
自调产线

en.name: Flexible Manufacturing and Smart Factory
en.gap: Manufacturing has shifted from fixed production lines to real-time reconfigurable smart networks, and old terms such as 'master craftsman', 'workstation' and 'production line' have acquired new meanings.
lexical: digital master craftsman
lights-out collaboration
self-adjusting production line

zh.name: 数字师傅
zh.gap: 专家经验被模型化后，师傅不只指人，也指可传授工艺的系统。
lexical: 师傅: 从熟练工人扩展为工艺模型
带徒: 从师徒制扩展为模型辅助培训
诀窍: 从经验口传扩展为参数化知识

en.name: Digital Master
en.gap: After expert experience is modeled, 'master' no longer refers only to humans, but also to systems that can impart production processes.
lexical: master: extends from skilled worker to process model
mentoring: extends from master-apprentice system to model-assisted training
know-how: extends from orally passed experience to parameterized knowledge

zh.name: 黑灯协作
zh.gap: 无人工厂中“工作现场”不再以人的视觉和作息为中心。
lexical: 黑灯: 从无照明状态扩展为无人化生产
现场: 从人在场扩展为传感器在场
巡检: 从人工查看扩展为自动感知

en.name: Lights-Out Collaboration
en.gap: In unmanned factories, the 'work site' is no longer centered on human vision and work schedules.
lexical: lights-out: extends from unlit state to unmanned production
site: extends from human presence to sensor presence
inspection: extends from manual checking to automatic sensing

zh.name: 自调产线
zh.gap: 产线根据订单、能耗和设备状态自动重排，缺少描述动态制造语法的词。
lexical: 产线: 从固定流程扩展为可重组网络
排产: 从计划表扩展为实时算法
换线: 从人工改造扩展为软件重配

en.name: Self-Tuning Production Line
en.gap: Production lines automatically rearrange based on orders, energy consumption and equipment status, and there is a lack of terms describing dynamic manufacturing syntax.
lexical: production line: extends from fixed process to reconfigurable network
production scheduling: extends from planning table to real-time algorithm
line changeover: extends from manual modification to software reconfiguration

zh.name: 边缘计算与个人智能界面
zh.gap: 计算从云端回到身体附近和环境之中，界面不再只是一块屏幕，旧词要扩展到耳机、眼镜、车舱和房间。
lexical: 本地大脑
第二感官
空间桌面
环境界面

en.name: Edge Computing and Personal Smart Interface
en.gap: Computing shifts from the cloud to areas close to the human body and the surrounding environment. Interfaces are no longer limited to a single screen, and the scope of relevant old terms needs to be extended to cover headphones, smart glasses, vehicle cabins and rooms.
lexical: Local Brain
Second Sense
Spatial Desktop
Ambient Interface

zh.name: 端侧AI
zh.gap: 智能在手机、传感器和设备本地运行，形成隐私、延迟和离线能力的新表达需求。
lexical: 端脑
离线智能
口袋模型

en.name: On-Device AI
en.gap: Intelligence runs locally on mobile phones, sensors and devices, creating new expression demands for privacy, low latency and offline capability.
lexical: On-Device Brain
Offline Intelligence
Pocket Model

zh.name: 本地大脑
zh.gap: 设备拥有可独立推理的智能，不再把一切发到云端。
lexical: 大脑: 从生物器官扩展为设备推理核心
本地: 从位置属性扩展为隐私架构
离线: 从断网状态扩展为自治能力

en.name: Local Brain
en.gap: Devices are equipped with independently reasoning intelligence, no longer sending all data to the cloud for processing.
lexical: brain: extends from biological organ to device reasoning core
local: extends from location attribute to privacy architecture
offline: extends from disconnected network state to autonomous capability

zh.name: 低延迟人格
zh.gap: 语音助手如果即时响应，会显得更像在场对象，速度改变社会感知。
lexical: 在场: 从物理同处扩展为实时响应感
脾气: 从人格特征扩展为交互风格
迟钝: 从认知评价扩展为系统延迟评价

en.name: Low Latency Persona
en.gap: If a voice assistant responds instantly, it will feel more like a present entity; speed alters social perception.
lexical: presence: extends from physical co-location to sense of real-time response
temper: extends from personality trait to interaction style
sluggishness: extends from cognitive evaluation to system latency assessment

zh.name: 私密推理
zh.gap: 推理发生在本地时，数据保护从传输安全转向过程可见性。
lexical: 私密: 从内容属性扩展为计算位置属性
不出端: 从空间表达扩展为数据治理承诺
可见: 从视觉状态扩展为审计透明度

en.name: Private Inference
en.gap: When inference runs locally, data protection shifts from transmission security to process visibility.
lexical: privacy: extends from content attribute to computing location attribute
no data leaving the device: extends from spatial expression to data governance commitment
visibility: extends from visual state to audit transparency

zh.name: 可穿戴与环境感知
zh.gap: AI进入眼镜、耳机、戒指、衣物和房间，需要描述持续感知、提醒和陪伴的微型词义。
lexical: 第二感官
耳边助理
环境记忆

en.name: Wearables and Environmental Perception
en.gap: AI is integrated into glasses, earphones, rings, clothing and rooms, requiring new micro lexical meanings to describe continuous perception, reminders and companionship.
lexical: Second Sense
Ear-side Assistant
Environmental Memory

zh.name: 第二感官
zh.gap: 设备补充人的听觉、视觉、位置和生理感知。
lexical: 感官: 从人体能力扩展为外接感知系统
看见: 从视觉行为扩展为算法识别
听懂: 从人类理解扩展为环境音解析

en.name: Second Sense
en.gap: Devices supplement human auditory, visual, positional and physiological perception.
lexical: sense: extends from human body capability to external perception system
see: extends from visual behavior to algorithmic recognition
understand speech: extends from human comprehension to ambient sound analysis

zh.name: 环境记忆

lexical: 记忆: 从心理能力扩展为空间记录
熟悉: 从人的经验扩展为环境个性化
忘记: 从认知丧失扩展为数据删除

en.name: Ambient Memory
en.gap: Rooms, cabins or offices can remember human habits and historical interactions.
lexical: memory: extends from psychological capability to spatial recording
familiar: extends from human experience to environmental personalization
forget: extends from cognitive loss to data deletion

zh.name: 微提醒

lexical: 提醒: 从显性告知扩展为轻触式干预
打扰: 从社交评价扩展为交互负担
贴心: 从情感评价扩展为时机准确性

en.name: Micro Reminder

lexical: reminder: extends from explicit notification to tap-style intervention
disturb: extends from social evaluation to interaction burden
thoughtful: extends from emotional evaluation to timing accuracy

zh.name: 空间计算
zh.gap: 数字信息叠加到真实空间，界面词汇从平面窗口迁移到地点、物体和动作。
lexical: 空间桌面
混合注释
场景图层

en.name: Spatial Computing
en.gap: Digital information is superimposed onto real space, and interface vocabulary migrates from flat windows to locations, objects and actions.
lexical: Spatial Desktop
Mixed Annotation
Scene Layer

zh.name: 空间桌面
zh.gap: 文件和应用不只在屏幕内，而是固定在房间、桌面或设备周围。
lexical: 桌面: 从屏幕隐喻扩展为真实空间布置
窗口: 从二维框扩展为空间视野
摆放: 从物品动作扩展为信息布局

zh.name: 混合注释
